themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across Europe and the United States are sharpening their political strategies and mobilizing supporters through high-profile party congresses and electoral campaigns. From Marine Le Pen's policy planning in France and Lega's high-stakes congress in Italy to Trump's multi-state campaign blitz, conservative movements are actively positioning themselves to capture legislative and executive momentum.

themes.title: Hardline Anti‑Immigration Policies Surge
themes.blurb: Hardline immigration stances and aggressive enforcement mechanisms remain central pillars of right-wing strategy in both North America and Europe. The U.S. administration continues pushing for wall construction and increased deportation enforcement, while European right-wing parties continue to push public debates focused on the financial and social costs of immigration.
